title: 6 Best AI Figma Plugins to Boost Your Design Efficiency
description: Six AI Figma plugins for layouts, copy, imagery and dark mode, what each one is for, and how to choose a Figma AI plugin worth keeping.

blocks.v: An AI Figma plugin takes over the repetitive parts of design work inside Figma itself: drafting a layout, filling a mockup with realistic content, converting a design to dark mode or cutting an image out of its background. Figma has added AI features of its own, but plugins still cover narrower jobs, and most are free to try.
Below are six AI Figma plugins worth trying, followed by how to choose a Figma AI plugin without filling your workspace with tools you open once.
The 6 best AI Figma plugins
Each entry says what the plugin does and who it suits. Features change between versions, so check the plugin’s Figma Community page for the current details and pricing.
1. Landify

Landify is an AI-powered plugin that simplifies the process of creating professional-looking UI designs. It provides designers with ready-made components, layouts, and templates that align with industry standards.
Key Features:

v: AI-powered layout suggestions – Quickly generate responsive layouts based on design best practices.
Pre-built UI components – Access a wide range of UI elements like buttons, forms, and cards.
Customization options – Easily tweak designs to fit your brand’s aesthetics.

blocks.v: Landify is ideal for designers looking to accelerate their workflow without compromising quality.
2. Lummi
Lummi is a library of AI-generated stock images that you can search and place from inside Figma, so mockups show realistic imagery instead of grey boxes.
Key Features:

v: Image search inside Figma – Find and place images without leaving the canvas.
Realistic mockups – Replace placeholder boxes with imagery that shows how the finished design will feel.
Licence terms – Check Lummi’s current terms before using images in client work.

blocks.v: Lummi suits designers who want mockups that look finished without a separate trip to a stock photo site.
3. Dark Mode Magic
Dark Mode Magic automatically converts designs into dark mode with a single click. Given the popularity of dark themes, it saves UI/UX designers a lot of manual work.
Key Features:

v: Automated dark mode conversion – No need to adjust every colour by hand.
Color contrast optimization – Ensures accessibility and readability.
Customizable settings – Modify elements based on preferences and branding.

blocks.v: This plugin is a must-have for designers who need to create both light and dark mode versions of their UI without extra effort.
4. PixCut Background Remover
PixCut Background Remover, developed by Wondershare, is an AI-powered tool that removes backgrounds from images within seconds.
Key Features:

v: One-click background removal – Easily cut out subjects from images.
High-precision AI algorithm – Ensures clean and crisp cutouts.
Bulk processing – Remove backgrounds from multiple images at once.

blocks.v: This plugin is highly useful for UI designers, marketers, and product designers who frequently work with images.
5. Vector Logos
Vector Logos provides high-quality vector logos of popular brands, making it easy for designers to include brand assets in their projects.
Key Features:

v: Extensive logo library – Access thousands of brand logos in vector format.
Scalable without quality loss – Maintain high resolution regardless of size.
Quick search and insert – Find and add logos to designs in seconds.

blocks.v: For designers working on corporate and branding projects, Vector Logos is a time-saving tool.
6. Writer for Figma
Writer for Figma is an AI-powered writing assistant that helps designers craft better UX copy, microcopy, and product descriptions directly within Figma.
Key Features:

v: Context-aware AI writing – Generates smart suggestions for UX copy.
Grammar and clarity enhancements – Improve readability and coherence.
Seamless Figma integration – Edit and refine text without switching applications.

blocks.v: This plugin is ideal for designers who want to create clear, concise, and engaging text without leaving Figma.
How to choose a Figma AI plugin
The Figma Community has a large and growing number of AI plugins, and most of them do something you will use once. A few questions separate the ones worth keeping.

v: Which job does it replace? If you cannot name a task you do every week that it removes, it is a novelty.
Does it produce editable layers? Output you have to rebuild by hand saves less time than it appears to.
Where does your file go? Many AI plugins send content to an outside service. Check before running one on client work covered by an NDA.
What does it cost after the trial? Free tiers often limit the number of generations.
Is it maintained? A recent update and active reviews on its Community page are a good sign.

blocks.v: Where AI Figma plugins help, and where they do not

They are strongest on first drafts and repetitive work: realistic content in a mockup, a dark version of an existing screen, a clean image cutout, alternative wording for a button. That is real time saved.

They are weakest where design is actually decided: what the screen is for, what the user needs first, what to leave out. A plugin can produce a layout quickly. It cannot tell you whether it is the right layout. That still comes from research and judgement, which is the part of [[UI/UX design|/services/ui-ux-design]] worth paying for.
FAQs
1. Are these AI Figma plugins free to use?
Most AI Figma plugins offer free versions with basic features. However, some have premium plans for advanced functionalities.
2. Does Figma have its own AI?

Yes. Figma has added AI features directly into the editor. They are separate from Community plugins, and many designers use both: the built-in features for general tasks and a Figma AI plugin for a specific job.
3. Do AI plugins slow down Figma performance?
While AI plugins use processing power, well-optimized plugins should not significantly affect Figma’s performance. If you experience lag, try disabling unused plugins.
4. Can I use these plugins without any coding knowledge?
Yes. These plugins are designed for designers and non-developers, so no code is needed to use them.
5. How do I install an AI plugin in Figma?
Search for the plugin in the Figma Community, or from the Actions menu inside a Figma file, then run it. There is no separate download.
6. Are AI-generated designs fully customizable?
Usually. Most AI Figma plugins place ordinary Figma layers on the canvas, so you can tweak and refine them as needed. Check this for any plugin before you rely on it.
Final Thoughts

AI Figma plugins are changing the way designers work by automating repetitive tasks, enhancing creativity, and improving efficiency. Whether you need automated layouts, better UX copy, or instant background removal, these six plugins can significantly boost your productivity.
Try one or two of these AI Figma plugins on a real project rather than installing all six at once. For non-AI plugins worth keeping, see [[six unique Figma plugins|/6-unique-powerful-figma-plugins]].
